newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays weak, bearish tone resumed.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays weak, bearish tone resumed.

text.p: London's spot December white sugar contract came under renewed selling pressure in modest Wednesday trade but price movements were thin as the bearish tone resumed.
Traders said the New York market's failure to maintain upside momentum had dulled sentiment in London, where trade sellers on the nearby contracts dominated much of the activity.
Earlier hedge sales were seen against the European Union's weekly tender for export licences and then the lacklustre raws performance compounded the weakness, they said.
At 1526 GMT December remained under its previous $320.00 support level, down just 10 cents at $319.70.
March was unchanged at $316.80 and the two nearbys accounted for the bulk of the total volume of 1,378 lots, with outright as well as switch trades cited.
Trading ranges were no more than $1.30 on any position.
Paris positions were also weaker, with December down 70 cents at $319.50 and March down $1.50 at $316.50. Matif volume totalled 718 lots.
